THE PROBLEM
Most people suspect food.
Almost none ever confirm it.
Food sensitivity tests are more accessible than ever. But buying a test is easy. Knowing what to do with it isn't. Without a structured process, most people eliminate a few things, feel slightly better, give up, and never get real answers.
Tests are easy to buy
But most people who buy a food sensitivity test never follow a proper elimination protocol.
Guessing doesn't work
Randomly cutting foods with no structure gives you no signal. You don't know what's helping.
No accountability
No daily check-ins, no AI tracking your symptoms, no verdicts at the end. Just a list and good luck.
HOW IT WORKS
Four steps to certainty.
01
Test
Complete your intake and at-home lab test. Your results become the starting hypothesis: the suspects, not the verdict.
02
Eliminate
Eight weeks without your target foods, with 30-second daily check-ins. Your symptoms settle into a clean baseline.
03
Reintroduce
Each food returns one at a time in a controlled cycle while we track your response. Your body gives the real answer.
04
Know
Every food lands where it belongs: Safe, Limit, or Avoid. Every verdict is earned and yours to keep.
